g.text: Metal slide bumps here so it is
Metal slide rests flat on this shelf hands-free
Drill bit & screwdriver reach through this hole!
Holds the heavy 18" metal carcass slides dead-level against the inside 2x4 posts,
automatically sets the 2.5mm setback, and lets you screw into the wood through the big center window.
The metal drawer slide rail rests on this step
Guarantees slide is 100% parallel to box bottom!
Hugs the side of the 1/2" Birch drawer box
Pinch thumb & finger here to pull block out!
Used on your workbench under the drawer box (one at the front, one at the rear).
Lifts the slide rail 1/4" off the bench so screws never rub, then you pinch the notch to pull them out.
JIG 3: 1/8" REVEAL SHIMS & BAMBU PRINT BED MATCHING MAP
Sets equal reveal around walnut faces
Grip to pull shims out after clamping
How to use: Place one shim on each of the 4 sides of the drawer front while clamping from inside.
